events.title: *Depose: Luigi Mangione, the Right to Health, and the Unfinished American Revolution* Book Launch Tour
events.venue: Wooden Shoe Books, 704 South St, Philadelphia, PA 19147
events.description:
A presentation and discussion about the forthcoming book, *Depose: Luigi Mangione, the Right to Health, and the Unfinished American Revolution,* written by The December 4 Legal Committee, the anonymous collective that created Mangione's official legal fund. The presentation will be given by a spokesperson for the authors.

The book will be published October 13 by Ill Will Editions and distributed by The MIT Press.
